matched_queries: UK employment guidance: Seafarers Charter standards and employer responsibilities for seafarers working on relevant maritime services.

passages.quote:
This notice should be read in conjunction with the Merchant Shipping (Maritime Labour Convention) (Survey and Certification) Regulations 2013 and the Merchant Shipping (Maritime Labour Convention) (Minimum Requirements for Seafarers etc.) Regulations 2014 and replaces MGN 472 amendment 3.

Amendment 4 updates references, and annex A list of substantial equivalents agreed by the MLC Tripartite Working Group.

Notice to

shipbuilders

shipowners

ship operators

employers

masters

seafarers

manning agents and agencies
